mapper.select: SELECT DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT_ID, USER_ID, DEPOSIT_PRODUCT_ID, WITHDRAW_ACCOUNT_NO, PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT, INTEREST_RATE, START_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, EXPECTED_INTEREST, EXPECTED_MATURITY_AMOUNT, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM FIXED_DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT WHERE DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT_ID = #{depositAccountId}

SELECT DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT_ID, USER_ID, DEPOSIT_PRODUCT_ID, WITHDRAW_ACCOUNT_NO, PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT, INTEREST_RATE, START_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, EXPECTED_INTEREST, EXPECTED_MATURITY_AMOUNT, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM FIXED_DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND MATURITY_DATE <= #{today}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FIXED_DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT (DEPOSIT_ACCOUNT_ID, USER_ID, DEPOSIT_PRODUCT_ID, WITHDRAW_ACCOUNT_NO, PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT, INTEREST_RATE, START_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, EXPECTED_INTEREST, EXPECTED_MATURITY_AMOUNT, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{depositAccountId}, #{userId}, #{depositProductId}, #{withdrawAccountNo}, #{principalAmount}, #{interestRate}, #{startDate}, #{maturityDate}, #{expectedInterest}, #{expectedMaturityAmount}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
